english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when materials or items are being recycled without stressing the processing or the act of carrying them out.
Use this for recovering or recycling waste and other recyclable materials.
Use this for reclaiming materials or discarded items so they can be reused, rather than for rescuing people.

examples.english: We can recycle these plastic bottles.
examples.traditional: 我哋可以回收呢啲膠樽。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 wui4 sau1 ni1 di1 gaau1 zeon1

examples.english: These plastic bottles can be taken away to reclaim the plastic.
examples.traditional: 呢啲膠樽可以攞去回收。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 gaau1 zeon1 ho2 ji5 lo2 heoi3 wui4 sau1

examples.english: We can salvage these old plastic bottles and reuse them.
examples.traditional: 呢啲舊膠樽可以回收再用。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 gaau1 zeon1 ho2 ji5 wui4 sau1 zoi3 jung6
